speaker: Doctor
text: I see the memory attack suggesting Pneumonia, but your symptoms of a pruritic rash and numbness on the palms do not match that condition. I need to gather more information to find the correct diagnosis. Can you describe the appearance of the rash and when these tingling sensations started?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of a chronic blistering rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), sensory neuropathy (tingling/numbness in palms), and significant risk factors like livestock exposure (hepatitis C/hepatotoxicity risk) and potential hemochromatosis or alcohol use strongly points to this diagnosis. I will request Liver_Function_Tests and Urine_Porphyrins to confirm.
